name: Farnborough Airport

runway.v: one runway, 06/24, 45 m wide; longest take-off run available 2,063 m (runway 24)

hours.v: open 07:00 to 22:00 on weekdays and 08:00 to 20:00 at weekends and on bank holidays; closed on Christmas Day and Boxing Day
hours.quote: Monday to Friday 07:00 – 22:00 ... Saturday, Sunday & Bank Holidays 08:00 – 20:00 ... Christmas Day & Boxing Day Closed

curfew.v: no flying outside 07:00-22:00 on weekdays and 08:00-20:00 at weekends and on bank holidays, except emergencies
curfew.quote: Between 7am and 10pm on weekdays ... Between 8am and 8pm at weekends and on Bank Holidays ... This is except for in an emergency.

max_aircraft.v: no business aircraft over 80 tonnes MTOW operated in 2024 (report states this as an outcome, not as the limit itself)
max_aircraft.quote: no business aviation aircraft heavier than 80 tonnes MTOW operated during the period

noise.v: no use of aircraft auxiliary power units between 22:30 and 06:30

handling.v: ground handling only by Farnborough Airport Ltd or approved third parties
handling.quote: No person other than FAL or approved third parties may carry out ground handling at the Airport.
